texto:
Urban gardening is the practice of growing plants in a city. Many people don't have big yards, so they use small spaces like balconies, windowsills, or even rooftops. This activity is becoming very popular in big cities because it helps connect people with nature. They plant everything from flowers to vegetables in pots and containers.

There are many benefits. First, urban gardening provides fresh and healthy food. People can eat vegetables they grew themselves, which often taste better and have no chemicals. It is also a good form of light exercise and a great way to spend time outdoors. Many people find it very relaxing; it helps reduce stress. Furthermore, it can build a sense of community. For example, some neighbors create shared gardens on rooftops and work together. This makes neighborhoods look greener and more beautiful, improving everyone's quality of life.

preguntas.pregunta: According to the text, which of the following is a benefit of urban gardening?

opciones.A: It requires a very large yard.
opciones.B: It can help lower stress levels.
opciones.C: It is only popular in small towns.
opciones.D: It is a very expensive hobby.
opciones.E: It can only be done indoors.

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es B porque el texto menciona directamente que la jardinería urbana es una actividad relajante. The text states, 'Many people find it very relaxing; it helps reduce stress'. Las otras opciones son incorrectas. La opción A es falsa porque el texto dice que la gente usa 'small spaces like balconies'. La opción C es incorrecta porque el texto especifica que es popular en 'big cities'. El texto no menciona el costo (D) y dice que se puede hacer en espacios exteriores como 'rooftops' (E).

preguntas.pregunta: What can be inferred from the text about the food from urban gardens?

opciones.A: It is difficult to grow vegetables in the city.
opciones.C: It is often healthier than food from a supermarket.
opciones.D: People in cities are not interested in nature.
opciones.E: Urban gardening makes neighborhoods less attractive.

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es C. El texto no lo dice directamente, pero podemos inferirlo. The text says that people can eat vegetables 'they grew themselves, which often taste better and have no chemicals'. Esto sugiere que la comida es más saludable que la que se compra en el supermercado, que podría contener químicos. The other options are incorrect. El texto no sugiere que sea difícil (A), de hecho, dice que es popular. Menciona que se cultivan 'vegetables' (B), no solo flores. Dice que la jardinería conecta a la gente con la naturaleza, contradiciendo la opción D. Finalmente, el texto afirma que hace los barrios 'greener and more beautiful', lo contrario de la opción E.
